**Security disclosure**

If you discovered a security vulnerability, please do NOT post exploit code or sensitive details in a public issue. Public disclosure can put users at risk.

Preferred private reporting options:
- Use the repository's security advisory mechanism (if enabled).
- Contact the maintainers via the contact address listed in the repository settings.

If none of the private channels are available, open an issue but please mark it clearly as a security report and request that maintainers make it private.

Provide the following details when reporting privately (avoid POC code in public):
- Affected component / module
- A short description of the vulnerability and impact
- Steps to reproduce (high level)
- Versions affected
- Any mitigation/workaround you recommend

Thank you for responsibly disclosing security issues — we take them seriously and will respond quickly. 🛡️
